statements.statement: You check facts, names, numbers and tone. Whoever sends it is responsible for it.

statements.statement: Pounds and people served come from the inventory system, never AI. Check recalls against the original notice.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Marcus said those numbers come from the inventory system; Tasha raised recall risk.

statements.statement: AI never decides who gets food, SNAP help or a volunteer role. A person decides.

statements.reason: Follows from the SNAP concern and the template default; the volunteer role is a mild extension but in the default's spirit.

statements.statement: Trained, certified outreach staff answer all eligibility questions.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Marcus said outreach staff are trained and certified.

statements.statement: If asked, we say honestly how we use AI. SNAP line callers always reach a person.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Corporate partners will ask, and Marcus said a person answers the SNAP line.

statements.statement: Tell your manager and Ken the same day.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Tasha said exactly this.

statements.statement: The board's executive committee approves the policy and changes. Managers go over it with staff.
statements.label: unsupported
statements.reason: The committee approving the policy is supported, but approving changes and managers walking staff through it were not said; limit to policy approval and use a general line for how staff learn it.

statements.statement: We review it in 12 months.
statements.label: default
statements.reason: Default review period.

statements.statement: Do we pay for or approve ChatGPT and Claude, which some staff use on their own? Is that in next year's budget?
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Marcus said paid accounts are next year's budget; ChatGPT and Claude were named as in use.

statements.statement: May volunteers, such as group leaders writing shift notes, use AI? With which tools?
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Tasha asked and it was not settled.

statements.statement: Do AI reminder texts in our scheduling software stay on? Do we tell volunteers?
statements.label: contradicts
statements.reason: Tasha said volunteers need no label but Marcus did not settle it; the call is mixed, so one could ask it, but whether to keep the feature on is open; the policy otherwise silently leaves the feature unaddressed, which is fine.

statements.statement: Who approves using a partner's logo or brand with AI, given one partnership agreement's AI clause?
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Marcus raised the agreement's AI clause; the approver was not settled.
